senses.gloss: ch. = h.זוּגpair, couple, team, set.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 9:25">Targ. II Kings IX, 25</cite>.
Targ. Jud. XVII, 10 זוג לבושין a set of garments; a. e.—בַּר זוֹג match, wife.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 2:18">Targ. Y. II, Gen. II, 18</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:16">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>מסרינן ליה ז׳ דרבנן</he> we give him two scholars (to escort him); <cite ref="Yoma 85b:5">Yoma 85ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זָוָוא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵃ</cite> top <he>כל דמטי יחכום זוּגֵיה</he> whosoever has a chance shall select his partner (as if for a dance); a. fr.—Pl. <he>זוּגֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 110a:11">Pes. 110ᵃ</cite> Ashm’dai … is appointed <he>אכולהו ז׳</he> overseer of all even numbers (of cups &c., which were believed to invite dangers); a. e.—

senses.gloss: (cmp. above זוג לבושין, a. זְוַד) an outfit for travelling, travelling cloak.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 15:9">Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 9</cite> (not <he>זונא</he>) garment for polster.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 100b:30">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>זביננא לך זיגא דמטו וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>זינא דמטיא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) I shall buy thee garments reaching to thy feet.—Pl. as above.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 92">Gen. R. s. 92</cite> <he>לבש זוּגוֹי</he> put on his travelling equipments; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 150:1">Yalk. Gen. 150</cite> <cite ref="F00012"><he>וגוהי</he></cite> read <he>זוּגוֹהִי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116a:4">B. Mets. 116ᵃ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="G00138"><he>זָוָוא</he> I</cite>.
